2608.29880.title: Perceive to Hypothesize, Verify to Ground: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Open-World Geo-Localization
2608.29880.paper_summary: Open-world geo-localization requires models to reason over ambiguous visual cues through multi-step reasoning and external knowledge grounding. While recent large vision-language models exhibit strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, existing approaches still suffer from perceptual hallucination and context drift due to the lack of explicit evidence-grounded verification. In this work, we reformulate geo-localization as a human-like perceive-then-verify reasoning problem and propose GeoPAVE (Geo-localization Perception-and-Verification-Engine), a bi-level agentic framework that contains perception-based hypothesis generation via single-pass rollouts and verification-based evidence grounding for decision actions: support, refute, and refine. To support rigorous evaluation, we further introduce PAVED, a novel dataset derived from real-world user check-in data, equipped with comprehensive reasoning trajectories featuring multi-hop queries, multi-round tool invocations, and structured perception-verification traces. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Arandinglv/GeoPAVE.
2608.29880.paper_summary_zh: 開放世界的地理定位需要模型通過多步推理和外部知識基礎來對模糊的視覺線索進行推理。雖然最近的大型視覺-語言模型展示了強大的多模態推理能力，但現有的方法仍然受到感知幻覺和上下文漂移的困擾，這是由於缺乏明確的證據基礎驗證。在這項工作中，我們將地理定位重新定義為一個類似人類的感知-然後-驗證推理問題，並提出GeoPAVE（地理定位感知與驗證引擎），這是一個雙層次的代理框架，包含基於感知的假設生成，通過單次回合進行，以及基於驗證的證據基礎，用於決策行動：支持、反駁和細化。為了支持嚴謹的評估，我們進一步引入了PAVED，一個源自真實世界用戶登錄數據的新數據集，配備了全面的推理軌跡，特徵包括多跳查詢、多輪工具調用和結構化的感知-驗證痕跡。該數據集和代碼可在 https://github.com/Arandinglv/GeoPAVE 獲得。
